name: Phu Long clam
summary: Ngao Phù Long is on the 28 July 2025 special-zone eat list. The 20 June 2013 board prints ngao, ngao vàng, and ngao trắng without the Phù Long label. They are not the same product.
howToEat: The special-zone account says eat it and does not give a method. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Phù Long is the northwest shore on the 5 April 2013 honey account. A door is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ngao Phù Long — the Cat Ba clam
seoDescription: Ngao Phù Long is on the Cat Ba special-zone eat list. The 2013 board’s unlabeled ngao is a different line. A current price is Check on arrival.
